name: Settlement Information 3
definition: Further information required for the settlement the transaction.

SettlementMethod.name: Settlement Method
SettlementMethod.definition: Method used to settle the (batch of) payment instructions.

SettlementAccount.name: Settlement Account
SettlementAccount.definition: A specific purpose account used to post debit and credit entries as a result of the transaction.

ClearingSystem.name: Clearing System
ClearingSystem.definition: Specification of a pre-agreed offering between clearing agents or the channel through which the payment instruction is processed.

InstructingReimbursementAgent.name: Instructing Reimbursement Agent
InstructingReimbursementAgent.definition: Specifies the agent through which the instructing agent will reimburse the instructed agent.||Usage: If the instructing and instructed agents have the same reimbursement agent, then only InstructingReimbursementAgent must be used.

InstructingReimbursementAgentAccount.name: Instructing Reimbursement Agent Account
InstructingReimbursementAgentAccount.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the instructing reimbursement agent account at its servicing agent in the payment chain.

InstructedReimbursementAgent.name: Instructed Reimbursement Agent
InstructedReimbursementAgent.definition: Agent at which the instructed agent will be reimbursed.||Usage: If InstructedReimbursementAgent contains a branch of the InstructedAgent, then the instructed agent will claim reimbursement from that branch/will be paid by that branch.||Usage: If InstructingAgent and InstructedAgent have the same reimbursement agent, then only InstructingReimbursementAgent must be used.

InstructedReimbursementAgentAccount.name: Instructed Reimbursement Agent Account
InstructedReimbursementAgentAccount.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the instructed reimbursement agent account at its servicing agent in the payment chain.

ThirdReimbursementAgent.name: Third Reimbursement Agent
ThirdReimbursementAgent.definition: Specifies the branch of the instructed agent where the amount of money will be made available when different from the instructed reimbursement agent.

ThirdReimbursementAgentAccount.name: Third Reimbursement Agent Account
ThirdReimbursementAgentAccount.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the third reimbursement agent account at its servicing agent in the payment chain.
